name: yf_crypto_info
description:
Profile and market statistics for one cryptocurrency against USD from Yahoo Finance (yfinance Ticker.info).
Returns: {symbol, info} where info is Yahoo's dictionary (e.g. name, description, previousClose, dayHigh, dayLow, volume, marketCap, fiftyTwoWeekHigh, fiftyTwoWeekLow, allTimeHigh).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (BTC, ETH or BTC-USD; "-USD" is appended when the symbol does not already end with it, so only USD pairs work; default BTC-USD).
Price history: openbb_crypto_price, av_crypto_daily; broader crypto data: cg_coin_markets. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "ETH"}

symbol.description: Crypto symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH or BTC-USD (-USD is appended if missing)
